trial_court: Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura District, case No.T.S. (DIV) 424/2023
case_name: Sri Ajoy Datta vs Smt. Priya Saha
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 13.03.2020. Appellant-husband instituted a divorce petition before the Learned Trial Court on the ground of cruelty. Suit proceeded ex-parte against respondent-wife.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to appear before the court does not necessarily mean that the suit is dismissed.
legal_principles.held: Despite service of notice through paper publication dated 05.05.2024, the respondent did not appear before the Court.
cited_cases: Sri Ajoy Datta vs Smt. Priya Saha on 29 June, 2026

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to respond to a notice does not necessarily mean that the other party has failed in their efforts.
legal_principles.held: The appellant further stated that despite his efforts to restore the conjugal life, the respondent-wife did not return to the matrimonial home.
cited_cases: Sri Ajoy Datta vs Smt. Priya Saha on 29 June, 2026

outcome.final_order: Decree in favour of the appellant-husband.
